summary: First E2E test of MekongGreen. All 31 backend pytest tests PASSED (100%) covering health, auth (admin/staff/bad creds), directories (6 provinces, 5 machine categories, 24 HTX, 1346 machines), map summary + HTX detail, dashboard KPI + charts + priority list, supply-demand (30 rows for 6x5, province filter works), HTX/Machine CRUD with duplicate detection, admin users/sync logs/system logs/thresholds/norms, RBAC (staff correctly gets 403 on admin endpoints), and Excel/PDF export (valid content-type + magic bytes). Frontend E2E via Playwright confirmed: Login split-50/50 loads and works, admin login redirects to /map, Leaflet OSM map renders with 24 markers, Dashboard shows 4 KPIs + 4 charts, Supply-Demand loads, Data Management + Admin pages accessible for admin, Reports page renders, Staff correctly redirected from /admin and /data-management to /map, bad credentials show inline error 'Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng'. No console errors observed other than the expected 401 on bad-login attempt.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~710 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, htx, machines, dashboard, reports, admin) once feature-stable.
JWT_SECRET falls back to a dev default when env var missing; ensure production sets JWT_SECRET in backend/.env.
dashboard/priority-list calls map_htx_summary(user=...) internally which recomputes everything on each request; acceptable at current scale but consider caching if data grows.
list_provinces / stages / seasons endpoints have no auth dependency - intentional? Consider protecting to align with other read endpoints.
test_admin_users_create_update relies on prior state (idempotent handling of 400 duplicate) - acceptable but could DELETE user in teardown when a user-delete endpoint exists.
seed_data_creation: Backend startup seeds provinces, categories, 24 HTX, ~1346 machines, thresholds, norms, sync logs. Tests created and left behind: TEST-HTX99 (deactivated), TEST_user@mekonggreen.vn (locked), a couple of TEST-DUP serial machines (cleaned up in test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full pytest suite in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All endpoints healthy. UI Login uses data-testid: login-page, login-email, login-password, login-submit, login-error. Map renders 24 markers on Leaflet. Frontend admin nav labels are 'Quản lý HTX & Máy' and 'Quản trị & Cấu hình' (not literal 'Users'). Staff redirect from admin-only routes to /map works.
